parameters.query: UPDATE evidence_items SET status = 'reserved' WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM evidence_items WHERE status = 'new' AND confidentiality <> 'private' ORDER BY CASE WHEN 'technology_radar'=ANY(tags) OR source_ref LIKE 'evergreen:%' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE kind WHEN 'real_work' THEN 1 WHEN 'publication' THEN 2 WHEN 'lab_demo' THEN 3 WHEN 'lesson' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, created_at LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING id, kind, title, situation, action_text, result_text, source_ref, proof_level, confidentiality, approved_claims, tags;

WITH inserted AS (INSERT INTO content_posts (evidence_id, pillar, hook, body, cta, hashtags, image_brief, risk_flags, approval_status, text_model, openai_response_id, token_usage) VALUES ($1::uuid, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::text[], $7, $8::text[], $9, $10, NULLIF($11, ''), NULLIF($12, '')::jsonb) RETURNING id), claim_rows AS (INSERT INTO claim_map (post_id, evidence_id, claim_text, allowed, reason) SELECT inserted.id, NULLIF(claim->>'evidence_id', '')::uuid, claim->>'claim', COALESCE((claim->>'allowed')::boolean, false), COALESCE(claim->>'reason', '') FROM inserted CROSS JOIN jsonb_array_elements($13::jsonb) AS claim RETURNING id), evidence_used AS (UPDATE evidence_items SET status = 'used', used_at = now() WHERE id = $1::uuid RETURNING id) SELECT inserted.id AS post_id, $9 AS approval_status FROM inserted;
